### A2.53 Merge a duplicate case into the earlier case

#### A2.53.1 Intent

**Business objective.** A duplicate case for the same customer and product merges into the earlier case, carrying its documents and decision log (REQ-CHO-010, Should, E2).

#### A2.53.2 Description

**Functional overview.** The customer and product are matched by ACE `person_key` and product. The earlier case is kept, and the documents and decision log of the duplicate case are carried to it.

**Trigger and actor.** Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1561).

**Prerequisites.** FEAT-CWC-02

##### A2.53.3.1 Validation rules, business rules and constraints

|---|---|---|
| BR-P3-053 | A duplicate case for the same customer and product, by ACE `person_key` and product, merges into the earlier case, carrying its documents and decision log | Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1561) |
